tokens.usage: Shared width for the overview side rails (Explore + space home). The rail is fluid between these two: it takes a share of the layout row up to `--width-side-rail`, and stops shrinking at `--width-side-rail-min`, below which `StickySideRail` drops it entirely rather than showing a rail too narrow to read.
